question: Who among the following was the successor of King Bimbisara to the throne of Magadha?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ajatashatru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ajatashatru** was the successor of King **Bimbisara** and ruled the powerful kingdom of **Magadha**.
 
• He is considered one of the most significant rulers of the **Haryanka dynasty**.
 
• Ajatashatru ascended the throne after allegedly imprisoning and killing his father, King **Bimbisara**.
 
• He was a contemporary of both **Gautama Buddha** and **Mahavira**, the founders of Buddhism and Jainism respectively.
